title: How AI Fails: An Interactive Pedagogical Tool for Demonstrating Dialectal Bias in Automated Toxicity Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative benchmarking of toxicity scores (including severe toxicity, obscenity, threat, insult, and identity hate) and False Positive Rates (FPR) by comparing a model's performance on a 10,000-sample corpus of African-American English (AAE) against a 10,000-sample corpus of Standard American English (SAE).

Qualitative evaluation via an interactive pedagogical tool using pre-compiled minimal pairs (e.g., substituting 'Christian' with 'Muslim' in identical sentences) to observe changes in model toxicity scores.

Qualitative evaluation using pre-compiled minimal pairs in an interactive web UI, as well as the inherent demographic evaluation involved in measuring disparate impact against African-American English (AAE).
Qualitative evaluation through an interactive pedagogical tool using pre-compiled minimal pairs to demonstrate toxicity score variations based on gender identity.
